deep_dive.title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous UAV Exploration in Wildfire Response
deep_dive.abstract: This study develops a deep reinforcement learning framework for training Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) agents to navigate and monitor simulated wildfire environments. Results show that agents learn increasingly stable and effective behaviors over time, as demonstrated by converging loss trends, improved reward signals, and more consistent navigation patterns such as fire-boundary tracking. Overall, these findings highlight the potential of deep reinforcement learning (DRL) based UAV systems for autonomous wildfire monitoring and suggest that environmental structure and reward design influence policy effectiveness.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 本文面向野火监测场景，开发深度强化学习框架训练无人机智能体在模拟野火环境中导航与巡查。实验表明智能体随时间学习到更稳定有效的行为，表现为损失收敛、奖励提升以及更一致的导航模式如沿火场边界跟踪。研究凸显了基于深度强化学习的无人机系统在自主野火监测中的潜力，并说明环境结构与奖励设计会影响策略有效性，是多智能体强化学习在真实任务中的应用探索。

quick_skim.title: HiRAD: A Flexible Large-Scale AGV Routing System
quick_skim.abstract: Automatic Guided Vehicles (AGVs) substantially boost warehouse throughput, but routing large-scale AGV fleets remains challenging. Classical Multi-Agent Pathfinding solvers suffer from exploding combinatorial complexity and super-quadratic runtime, while relying on idealized grid or piecewise-linear motion models that mismatch real-world kinematics. Recent Reinforcement Learning (RL) solutions improve flexibility via decentralized agent policies but depend on discretized spatiotemporal representations, require millions of episodes to converge, and incur full-map observation at every step, which leads to large models, slow convergence, and high inference latency that violates real-time industrial control constraints. To address these bottlenecks, we propose HiRAD, a hierarchical RL framework for continuous-space AGV routing with real-time guarantees: (1) a step-level spatiotemporal representation that translates continuous motion into a differentiable RL problem, (2) a hierarchical strategy that splits heading choice from velocity control to reduce the action space, and (3) an asynchronous event-driven decision pipeline that lowers inference complexity from O(n^2) to O(n) and cuts per-step latency by as much as 71 percent. Across random graphs and two warehouse maps, HiRAD reduces makespan by 45 percent to 63 percent and shortens end-to-end runtime.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Proposes HiRAD, a hierarchical routing system for large-scale AGV fleets that uses decentralized learning-based agent policies to overcome combinatorial pathfinding and slow, high-latency RL routing.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对大规模AGV车队路由中经典多智能体路径规划组合复杂度过高、现有强化学习方案依赖离散时空表示且收敛慢、推理延迟大的问题，本文提出HiRAD分层路由系统，采用去中心化智能体策略并优化表示与推理效率以适应实时工业控制约束。系统面向真实仓储场景，缓解了模型庞大、收敛缓慢与高延迟等瓶颈。该工作为大规模AGV车队的去中心化多智能体强化学习路由提供了可扩展的实用方案。
